name: BMW R80G/S
engine: 798 cc air-cooled boxer twin, two carbs, Monolever shaft drive
intro: The first GS. An airhead boxer with the single-sided Monolever. Check the splines and the final drive.

add.title: Lube the drive splines
add.instructions: Pull the rear drive and clean and grease the shaft splines with a moly paste. Look for oil in the swingarm.
add.reason: Dry splines wear and fail. Most owners forget to grease them.

G: The Bing carbs need their diaphragms checked and the two sides balanced after any work.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
